title: Emerging organophosphate ester resorcinol bis(diphenyl phosphate) exerts estrogenic effects via estrogen receptor pathways.
authors: Xie, Yue; Zhang, Qi; Chen, Lu; Li, Fangfang; Li, Minjie; Guo, Liang-Hong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究有机磷酸酯RDP通过雌激素受体通路发挥雌激素效应，分子对接仅用于小分子-蛋白结合，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Environmental occurrence and human exposure of emerging organophosphate esters (eOPEs) have increased significantly in recent years. Resorcinol bis(diphenyl) phosphate (RDP) is one of the major eOPEs detected in indoor dust, but the knowledge on its toxicities and health risks is rather limited. In this study, we investigated the in vitro estrogenic effects and underlying mechanism of RDP in comparison with a legacy OPE triphenyl phosphate (TPHP). Our results showed that RDP promoted MCF-7 cell proliferation with the lowest effect concentration of 2.5 muM, and the maximum enhancement of 1.6 folds is greater than that of TPHP (1.3 folds). The effect was inhibited completely by an estrogen receptor (ER) antagonist, suggesting that ER activation was responsible for the enhancement. In luciferase reporter gene assays both RDP and TPHP activated ER transcriptional activity at 2.5 muM, but RDP activity was higher than TPHP. Competitive fluorescence binding assays showed that RDP bound to ER with an IC(10) of 0.26 muM, which is 20 folds lower than TPHP (5.6 muM). Molecular docking simulation revealed that both RDP and TPHP interacted with ER at the binding pocket of estradiol, although the hydrogen bonds were different. Taken together, RDP exerted stronger estrogenic effects than TPHP through ER-mediated pathways and may pose more health risks.
abstract_zh: 近年来，新兴有机磷酸酯（eOPEs）的环境存在及人体暴露显著增加。间苯二酚双（二苯基）磷酸酯（RDP）是室内灰尘中检测到的主要eOPEs之一，但关于其毒性和健康风险的了解相当有限。在本研究中，我们调查了RDP与一种传统OPE磷酸三苯酯（TPHP）相比的体外雌激素效应及其潜在机制。我们的结果表明，RDP促进了MCF-7细胞增殖，最低效应浓度为2.5 μM，最大增强倍数为1.6倍，高于TPHP（1.3倍）。该效应被雌激素受体（ER）拮抗剂完全抑制，表明ER激活是导致增强的原因。在荧光素酶报告基因实验中，RDP和TPHP均在2.5 μM时激活了ER转录活性，但RDP的活性高于TPHP。竞争性荧光结合实验显示，RDP与ER结合的IC(10)为0.26 μM，比TPHP（5.6 μM）低20倍。分子对接模拟揭示，RDP和TPHP均与ER在雌二醇结合口袋处相互作用，尽管氢键有所不同。综合来看，RDP通过ER介导途径表现出比TPHP更强的雌激素效应，并可能带来更高的健康风险。
